$comment: Build inputs for the two upstream skills this repo reworks.
`files` is the whitelist: only these paths are read from upstream/ and written to
skills/. Anything else under upstream/ is ignored (for example agents/openai.yaml),
and anything else under the generated skill directories is removed by the build.
Each op id X resolves to deltas/X.expect.md (text that must occur exactly once in its
upstream file) and deltas/X.fragment.md (its replacement, applied verbatim). Both files
must end with a newline. Ops run in listed order per file; anything not covered by an op
is inherited verbatim from upstream/. Regenerate with `node deltas/build.mjs`; verify

wayfinder/SKILL.md.note: The resolution is recorded in the lighthouse document, not as a tracker comment.
New section separating decision tickets from task tickets. The anchor heading '## Fog of war' is re-emitted at the end of the fragment.
The trigger for ruling a ticket out of scope is a lighthouse decision.
Step 0 loads the tracker vocabulary; the step 1 line is re-emitted.
Steps 4-6 make lighthouse and backtracer mandatory, replacing upstream's comment-and-close step.

setup-matt-pocock-skills/SKILL.md.note: Two ticket vocabularies instead of five canonical roles.
Section B asks about the decision and task vocabularies plus the shared labels.

setup-matt-pocock-skills/triage-labels.m.note: The five-role mapping table is replaced by the two-vocabulary model; the '# Triage Labels' heading is inherited from upstream.

setup-matt-pocock-skills/issue-tracker-l.note: decision/ and issues/ are separate ticket directories.
Publishing routes decision tickets to decision/ and task tickets to issues/.
Child tickets are decision tickets with the open/claimed/resolved vocabulary.
Resolve runs lighthouse and records the discussion in the ticket body.
